answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 22455 Country: India Title: What is "HIBBA" under property? Can it be done with or without the knowledge of the siblings? Please explain under shariah and its legality. Question: What is "HIBBA" under property? Can it be done with or without the knowledge of the siblings? Please explain under shariah and its legality. Answer ID: 22455 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 803/803/M=1431) Possession is a condition for hibah (gift) to be valid, though it is of property or something else. و تتم الهبة بالقبض الكامل (درمختار) I.e. wahib (donor) gives the thing completely in the possession of mauhoob lahu (donee or beneficiary) and becomes disconnected from it. If father wants to give his property as hibah (gift) to other than his children, he can do so without informing his children. However, with the intension of depriving one’s own children, it is not right to give whole property to someone else. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
